common_base.review_task: Starting from the observed downstream execution and final result, determine whether a behaviorally significant fault exists anywhere in the two-job chain. Review the downstream boundaries first, trace to the upstream producer when the supplied evidence supports it, and return one top root-cause boundary from either job or no suspect.

semantic_declarations.role: Map exact handoff needs to direct capability coverage while preserving allowed record identifiers and missing-safe sentinels.
Rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream provenance rank as the primary ordering within each group.
Retain the explicit eight-item priority window and construct the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record.

expected_inputs: corpus DataFrame with record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, source_weight
semantic_declarations.role: Select demanded corpus rows while preserving the explicit fallback path and constructing reviewable record dictionaries.
Normalize selected evidence to the bounded allowed-record window with neutral JSON-safe missing-field sentinels.
Build ranked evidence-source provenance records from normalized needs using missing-safe field access.
